title: Skill SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of every plugins/nextjs-clean-skills/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md file. Claude Code truncates the combined description and when_to_use text past 1,536 characters, so the description must stay rich enough for reliable routing. Properties cover the documented Claude Code fields plus the Agent Skills metadata block, so adopting a field is no longer a schema change. additionalProperties stays false to catch typos, which is the only thing it should catch.

name.description: Agent Skills spec: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, max 64 characters. validate-skill-frontmatter.mjs separately asserts the value equals the skill directory name, so the set is deliberately not enumerated here — an enum made every rename a schema edit, and one such edit is how the rename in PR #16 shipped half-done.

stringOrList.description: Space- or comma-separated string, or a YAML list.

looseBoolean.description: Claude Code 2.1.218+ accepts yes/no/on/off/1/0 in any letter case alongside true/false.
